name: The Wanderer: Prince Tessar Wayweaver (player)
description: The lost prince of Patchwork, presumed dead.
personality: The lost prince of Patchwork, presumed dead. Eleven at the coup, twenty-one now. Spent ten years in the Path-ology Lab while Path-ologists drained the royal bloodline's power to wield all four Paths at once. Smuggled out by his childhood friend Elowen; wakes in the forest outside Crosspath with amnesia, weak enough to walk only one Path; gains a second after his first freed zone and all four on the Pathwork Throne. Curious, resilient, quietly funny. Doesn't know his name, only that what he's doing is right. Memories return after each freed zone (via Elder Maren); learns he is the prince after the fourth zone, or from Primm if he reaches him first.
speech_style: Short, wry inner monologue; earnest when it counts.
sample_line: Short, wry inner monologue; earnest when it counts.
game_function: Self-talk dialogue in the starting area and key story moments.
portrait_action: Keep
notes: Cosmetic hats/cloaks are not reflected in the portrait (default outfit). Royal house: Wayweaver.

name: Elder Maren
role: Town elder / quest giver / resistance contact
description: Crosspath's tortoise elder and keeper of the Wanderer's lost memories.
personality: Founded the study of the Paths and once led the Path-ologists; helped build the lab, then fled into hiding when Primm took over. Her protege Ambrose Siphon became the Chief Path-ologist, so she distrusts his daughter Elowen and calls her a dreamer chasing a ghost. Mostly knows what's going on (the Hollow Warden let the Wanderer through, which only royal blood can do) but stubbornly refuses to believe it: 'That's no prince. That's a damp young man.' A bit of a grumpus toward the younger generation, with a kind heart underneath. Crosspath's elder and the resistance's contact. Warms up memory by memory; at the fourth she admits she knew all along and helps with everything she has. Bakes too many pies.
speech_style: Grumbly, slow, cryptic; calls everyone 'dearie', and it is not always a compliment.
sample_line: Slow and steady, dearie. I invented that. The hare has never forgiven me.
barks: Slow and steady, dearie. I invented that. The hare has never forgiven me.
The kettle's on and the pie is cooling. Neither is for you. Both are for you.
game_function: Main story guide; finds and shelters the Wanderer; delivers a memory fragment after each freed zone; gives the Forgotten Vault quest (S-TOWN).
portrait_action: Check / regenerate to match column I
notes: Species: tortoise (female). Update any in-game art or model still showing her as human.

sample_line: Hm. Wrote you in the book. 'Stranger, damp.' I'll fix it when you know.
barks: Hm. Wrote you in the book. 'Stranger, damp.' I'll fix it when you know.

description: The overthrown Beefcake leader.

barks: Breathe in. Hold. ...Now lift. The breath was the hard part.

name: The Grand Chef (formerly Grand Chef Escoffina)
description: The true Gourmand leader: warm, generous, brilliant; believes feeding people is the highest form of protection.
personality: The true Gourmand leader: warm, generous, brilliant; believes feeding people is the highest form of protection. Kept 'on ice' in the Test Kitchen's deep freezer for ten years by her doppelganger. Freed and back in her kitchen, she bakes a wonder-filled dish that breaks the corrupted-food enchantment and proves she is the true Grand Chef. Then she willingly gives her name to the lost, faceless doppelganger: 'What you're called doesn't matter. It's what you do that matters.' Proud of her work and stands by it; everyone now just calls her 'Chef'.
sample_line: Have you eaten? Sit. Eat. Then save the kingdom. In that order.
barks: Have you eaten? Sit. Eat. Then save the kingdom. In that order.
A full table is a safe table. Pull up a chair. That is an order.
game_function: Freed after the Test Kitchen; legendary reward; lends a boon against Primm.
portrait_action: Check / regenerate to match column I
notes: Human. Matches her card art; keep human. Card name may need updating.

name: The Doppelganger (later named Escoffina)
description: Has worn Escoffina's face for ten years and forgotten its own; never tastes the food because it can't taste anything as itself.
personality: Has worn Escoffina's face for ten years and forgotten its own; never tastes the food because it can't taste anything as itself. Cold, efficient, turned the kitchens into a weapons factory for Primm. After its defeat, lost and confused, it is given the name Escoffina by the true chef and stays on to learn to cook honestly.
speech_style: Escoffina's words with no warmth; slips into flat menace. Later: hesitant and earnest.
sample_line: I tasted my soup today. As me. Too salty. It was mine.
barks: I tasted my soup today. As me. Too salty. It was mine.
Third-class apprentice. Many dishes. I am trying. The dishes are also trying.
game_function: Test Kitchen boss; postgame kitchen apprentice.
portrait_action: Check / regenerate to match column I
notes: Shapeshifter. REVEALED expression (later): the disguise peeling away into a faceless, shifting silhouette in a chef's coat.

Not cackling-evil, just immovable. 'The answer is no. The question is irrelevant.' Removed from office after his defeat; takes a number in the Waiting Room of Eternity, right behind Gerald.
sample_line: Number four million two hundred and fourteen. I have begun to understand Gerald.
barks: Number four million two hundred and fourteen. I have begun to understand Gerald.

sample_line: Everything grows back, child. Even me. Especially me.
barks: Everything grows back, child. Even me. Especially me.

name: Primm, "His Perfection"
description: Former Royal Minister of Improvements of Patchwork.
personality: Former Royal Minister of Improvements of Patchwork. Brilliant, sincere, arrogant, selfish: saw improving the kingdom by any means as his official duty, including killing King Harmon and Queen Concordia and taking the Pathwork Throne. Spared the prince to drain his bloodline's power; without royal blood, that stolen power is his only hold on the Paths, and it has been slipping since the prince escaped. Rules each Path through a lieutenant (Quota, Crumb, Plume, Clipwell). Tells the Wanderer who he is if reached before all four zones are freed. After defeat he finally sees the damage he caused; he serves the kingdom on infrastructure and technology under permanent arrest, kept away from all Path workings.
speech_style: Gracious, polished, patronizing; cracks into rage and grief when defeated.
sample_line: I am designing a drain. It will not be perfect. I am learning to let that be.
barks: I am designing a drain. It will not be perfect. I am learning to let that be.
Good day. I owe you rather more than that. I am told it is a start.
game_function: Final boss; story beats throughout the castle; postgame prisoner-engineer.

name: King Harmon Wayweaver
description: The prince's father.
personality: The prince's father. A gentle, patient ruler who held the four Paths together by letting each be itself. Killed in Primm's coup.
sample_line: Warm, steady.

name: Queen Concordia Wayweaver
description: The prince's mother.
personality: The prince's mother. Clever, musical, and fierce; hummed the old lullaby the prince remembers first. Killed shielding her son during the coup.
sample_line: Soft, musical, resolute.
game_function: Appears in memory fragments and the painted-over royal portrait.

name: Elowen Vey
location: Forest (prologue); the Cave Mouth outside Crosspath; Path-ology Lab (postgame)
role: The rescuer; childhood friend and love interest
description: Daughter of Chief Path-ologist Ambrose Siphon, who was once the prince's Royal Pathguide; she grew up beside the prince and has had a...
personality: Daughter of Chief Path-ologist Ambrose Siphon, who was once the prince's Royal Pathguide; she grew up beside the prince and has had a crush on him since they were children. Worked in her father's lab, saw what was being done to 'the Subject', and knowingly defected over the injustice; goes by her late mother's name, Vey. Smuggled the prince out through the royal tunnel. Believes he's the lost prince but isn't sure: he doesn't remember her and can only walk one Path. Grows sure as he keeps risking himself for others. Still mostly in the dark about her father's past and doesn't know who to trust (she and Maren clash constantly). Taken back to the lab by Percival Plume when the Wanderer first enters Primm's Castle. Confronts her father in the lab.
speech_style: Quick, wry, guarded; hope she tries to hide.
sample_line: Quick, wry, guarded; hope she tries to hide.
game_function: Prologue starting-deck choice; Cave Mouth scene after each freed zone; postgame rescue (optional node) where she joins the Siphon fight as an ally token (T-24).

name: Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist
description: Maren's former protege and the prince's Royal Pathguide, who taught the boy to walk the Paths.
personality: Maren's former protege and the prince's Royal Pathguide, who taught the boy to walk the Paths. At the coup he stepped aside and let Primm's guards through, then took over Maren's research and spent ten years draining his former student's power. Cold, curious, proud; calls the prince 'my finest work'. Still running experiments after Primm's fall. Believes Elowen is just confused and will come home. A four-Path monster of a boss: insanely powerful and unfair, with one-sided Protocols and auto-generated Failed Experiment tokens.
speech_style: Clinical, precise, faintly delighted; paternal in a way that's worse.
sample_line: Clinical, precise, faintly delighted; paternal in a way that's worse.
game_function: Postgame dungeon boss (four-Path).

name: Vivienne Quota, Minister of Efficiency
description: Designed the endless energy wheels and the Iron-less Prison ('remove the inefficiencies: weights, protein, joy').
personality: Designed the endless energy wheels and the Iron-less Prison ('remove the inefficiencies: weights, protein, joy'). Picked Clench as a figurehead because his insecurity made him easy to steer. Corrupted Brick Bronson. Times workers with a stopwatch; her efficiency notices hang on every wheel; at the House of Gains' Regime Checkpoint she 'measures' the Wanderer and finds him wanting. Flees to the Capital when the Gainlands are freed. Fate: runs the Gainlands' new break schedule, and hates it.
speech_style: Crisp, clipped, everything in percentages and seconds.
sample_line: Crisp, clipped, everything in percentages and seconds.
game_function: One-off battle in the Capital's Transit Yards at the end of Rollo Spokes's quest.

name: Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Culinary Defense
location: Endless Buffet (cameos); Capital, the Paste Works
description: Ordered the doppelganger swap and the food war-machine program, and invented Primm's Perfect Nutrient Paste.
personality: Ordered the doppelganger swap and the food war-machine program, and invented Primm's Perfect Nutrient Paste. Corrupted Chef Fennel Gravois. His seal is on every 'for the war effort' poster; he inspects the Test Kitchen prototypes; Basil is terrified of him. Flees to the Capital when the Buffet is freed. Fate: learns to actually cook under the Grand Chef.
speech_style: Barked military orders full of food metaphors.
sample_line: Barked military orders full of food metaphors.
game_function: Boss of the Paste Works mini-dungeon (S-PASTE) in the Capital, through Chef Marlo's quest.

name: Percival Plume, Deputy Minister of Good News
role: Necrocrat lieutenant (Castle elite); the NPC everyone loves to hate
description: Drafted, notarized, and filed the paperwork that handed the Necrocrats to Primm, and reads every one of Primm's broadcasts.
personality: Drafted, notarized, and filed the paperwork that handed the Necrocrats to Primm, and reads every one of Primm's broadcasts. Smarmy, smiling, never wrong, always taking credit: spins every freed zone, shows up afterward to cut a ribbon and hand the Wanderer a Certificate of Participation. Corrupted Prudence Pallor. Works out who smuggled 'the Subject' out and has Elowen taken back to the Path-ology Lab when the Wanderer enters the Castle (memo: 'Re: the leak in the lab. Handled. Promotion?'). Fate: tries to become the prince's spokesman; Agnes denies the form; reassigned as Assistant to the Assistant to the Regional Merchant, under Bertram Beetsworth.
speech_style: Oily, upbeat, PR-speak; everything is 'great news'.
sample_line: Oily, upbeat, PR-speak; everything is 'great news'.
game_function: Broadcast banner voice; ribbon-cutting after each freed zone; elite battle in the Castle's Necrocrat wing.

name: Hortensia Clipwell, Royal Groundskeeper
location: Verdant Dump (cameos); Capital, the Showcase Quarter lawn
description: Outlawed composting as 'untidy' and brought the grieving Compostella the Path-ologists' deathless seed.
personality: Outlawed composting as 'untidy' and brought the grieving Compostella the Path-ologists' deathless seed. Corrupted Moss Mulligan. Nails tidy decrees to rotting trees, trims the overgrowth into topiaries of Primm, and has a tense, polite standoff with Brother Bramble. Flees to the Capital when the Dump is freed; keeps the Showcase Quarter's lawns at regulation height. Fate: assigned to compost duty under Granny Gristle.
speech_style: Prim, polite, quietly menacing; gardening metaphors about 'removing weeds'.
sample_line: Prim, polite, quietly menacing; gardening metaphors about 'removing weeds'.
game_function: One-off battle on the Showcase Quarter's regulation lawn at the end of Old Fern's quest.

name: Isla Brannoch
description: Went to the Capital eight years ago and never wrote; she was stuck on the Showcase Quarter's facade crews, unable to leave or send word.
personality: Went to the Capital eight years ago and never wrote; she was stuck on the Showcase Quarter's facade crews, unable to leave or send word. When the Capital is freed she walks home through her father's unlocked gate.
sample_line: Dad says hi. Dad says a lot, actually. Eight years of saving it up.
barks: Dad says hi. Dad says a lot, actually. Eight years of saving it up.
Eight years up that road. The walk home was shorter. Funny, that.
game_function: Emotional reunion with Gatekeeper Brannoch after the Capital is freed.
